description: This file declares the interface for the FileCheck utility used in testing, which allows pattern matching and validation within test strings or graph IR dumps in the PyTorch JIT subsystem.

classes.name: FileCheck
classes.description: A utility class for running pattern checks on strings or graph IR, supporting various match and check methods

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs pattern checks against a test string or a graph IR dump.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks for the occurrence of a string after the most recent match.

methods.name: check_not
methods.description: Ensures a string does not occur between matches.

methods.name: check_same
methods.description: Checks that a string occurs on the same line as the previous match.

methods.name: check_next
methods.description: Checks that a string occurs on the line immediately after the previous match.

methods.name: check_count
methods.description: Checks that a string occurs a specific number of times.

methods.name: check_dag
methods.description: Checks a group of patterns in any order, starting from the end of the previous match.

methods.name: check_source_highlighted
methods.description: Validates that a source token is highlighted in the provided string.

methods.name: check_regex
methods.description: Checks that a regex pattern matches and occurs at the expected position.
